description: Opgave wateroverlast, Waterbeheerplan is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.aaenmaas.nl. The use of water storage areas is part of the strategic measures to prevent flooding and flooding. Municipalities are working on solving bottleneck areas in urban areas with existing or foreseeable flooding. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Problem of flooding, Water management plan" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Waterbeheerplan. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
